question: Where is Morgan Stanley investing in technology for its advisors?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Morgan Stanley is investing to broaden capabilities for financial advisors in: alternatives and privates, tax-efficient investing, digitized assets, family office and OCIO, and tailored lending.
items.quote: We are using our scale to invest in broadening capabilities for FAs that are difficult for others to replicate: alternatives and privates, tax-efficient investing, digitized assets, family office and OCIO, and tailored lending.

items.text: Morgan Stanley's scale supports continued investment in future technology including AI and digital tools.
items.quote: our scale supports continued investment in future technology, including AI and digital tools

items.text: Morgan Stanley is developing LeadIQ, an AI-powered lead distribution platform focused on matching workplace and self-directed relationships and facilitating engagement with financial advisors.
items.quote: LeadIQ, our AI-powered lead distribution platform, focusing on matching workplace and self-directed relationships and facilitating engagement with our financial advisors.

items.text: The firm is investing in products like LeadIQ that allow matching individuals with advisers.
items.quote: They're going into products like LeadIQ that will allow us to match individuals with advisers.

items.text: Morgan Stanley is developing co-piloting/'super agents'/corridors to drive efficiency and effectiveness for financial advisors, giving advisors historical context of client interactions.
items.quote: that co-piloting... where they effectively have corridors or super agents that are going to be working to drive, again, efficiency and effectiveness across the portfolio in wealth.

items.text: The firm is developing the DevGen AI tool which enhances developer efficiency by modernizing code.
items.quote: DevGen AI tool, which enhances developer efficiency by modernizing code

items.text: The firm is developing Parable, an interactive tool that quickly analyzes and summarizes data.
items.quote: Parable, an interactive tool that quickly analyzes and summarizes data

items.text: The firm is investing in adjacent digital asset product and announced partnerships with Zero Hash in digital assets.
items.quote: whether it's investing in adjacent digital asset product... we continue to invest, deepening our competitive moats in areas like... digital assets through announced partnerships with Zero Hash.

items.text: Morgan Stanley has invested in E*TRADE Pro, a new tool for the self-directed channel.
items.quote: We've put in new tools like E*TRADE Pro.

items.text: The firm uses unique data from wealth management to allow FAs to tailor advice and equip tools to deliver that advice.
items.quote: It gives us insights given our size and scale that allow our FAs to tailor advice and equip our own tools to deliver that advice to help clients achieve their goals.

items.text: The firm has put digital tools, digital enhancements and automation in place to help with the paper backlog associated with lending products.
items.quote: we've put in a lot of resources towards lending products more broadly. So digital tools, digital enhancements and using automation to be able to help with the paper backlog associated with some of the various lending products more broadly.

items.text: The firm expanded its collaboration with Carta in private markets.
items.quote: deepening our competitive moats in areas like our expanded collaboration with Carta in private markets

cells.reason: Multiple passages state specific tools and capabilities being built or deployed for advisors, satisfying the fact sub-question.
